text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolve] Lv.6 w/[Jesmon] in name + Lv.6 w/[Gankoomon] in name: Cost 0

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 [Royal Knight] trait card from your hand or trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon. [When Attacking] [Once per Turn] This Digimon unsuspends. Then, for every 2 [Royal Knight] trait cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash your opponent's top security card.

text_sections.label: Special Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-5)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 5 memory.)
